keyLimits.en: Perpetual license, one year of feature updates included; usable on up to 2 computers per license; renewal needed to receive feature releases issued after the first year.

cautions.en: No free trial mentioned; the $75 purchase is required to test the plugin.

capabilities.en: Transfers layers from Figma, Photoshop and Illustrator into After Effects while preserving properties (masks, gradients, styles, names).
Editable text layers with per-character styling (kerning, color, font weight) carried over from source apps.
Bidirectional transfers between Figma and Illustrator; fast precomp/decomp and clipping mask operations.
Figma frame transfers with pixel density matching.

limitations.en: Freeform and mesh gradients cannot be rendered as After Effects shape layers; they must be rasterized to PNG instead.
Requires specific minimum app versions: After Effects/Illustrator CC 2022+, Photoshop 2025+, Windows 10 22H2+ or macOS Monterey 12+.

reason.en: Another After Effects plugin/extension used in motion design pipelines, though for a different purpose (Lottie export vs. layer transfer).
Another cross-tool bridge plugin connecting Figma to other production workflows.

unknowns: Team or multi-seat pricing beyond the Single User license is not published on the page.
